## Checklist

- [ ] runs without errors
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` / `ruff check .` / `mypy .` / `pytest -q` green
- [ ] tested manually
- [ ] new behaviour ships with at least one test
- [ ] no regressions on existing features
- [ ] rebased on latest `master` (resolving conflicts before opening the PR is the opener's responsibility)
- [ ] no sensitive data or secrets committed (`gitleaks` green)
